race.description: Cetnaj Country Magic Merv Mercer Mile Hcp (C2)
race.comment: SATIN AND CASH (5) improved sharply this time in and is chasing her third win from her last four starts today. Sat just off the fast speed over the 1400m with an authoritative victory at Grafton. Looks ready for the 1600m from the right gate. Has genuine claims. VIXENETTE (1) fifth-up for this and a win looks imminent. Knocked up late with a sound on speed third over 1600m at Grafton. Bullock sticks and shapes as one of the leading contenders. CALEDONIAN (11) is going better than his recent runs suggest and can race closer today from the inside barrier. Taken back from the wide gate and was strong through the line when fifth over 1700m at Scone. Value prospect. NO WOMAN NO CRY (6) rewarded for his consistency when he accounted for a Maiden field with a dominant victory over 1630m at Grafton. Jumps a few grades here and keep safe despite drawing out.
